snippet.title: Green 9 Deal (Trailer)
snippet.description:
itch.io link: https://kurantob.itch.io/green-9-deal


Psst, hey. Do you have what it takes? Do you really think you are best crazy ice fairy climate activist in your corner of the solar system?
Try our game now with an online scoreboard!



This has been a game that traces its origin to the "9 Jam," held from 1 Sept to 9 Sept 2019. It was themed around Cirno, an ice fairy from Touhou Project.
